sentences.text: Anaerostipes is a genus of anaerobic butyrate-producing gut bacteria belonging to the Clostridium cluster of the Firmicutes.
Strains of Anaerostipes caccae were isolated from human faeces as bacteria that consume lactate and make butyrate as their main fermentation product.
In culture, Anaerostipes caccae failed to grow on starch alone but grew in coculture with Bifidobacterium adolescentis, an example of metabolic cross-feeding.
Butyrate made by this group is described as physiologically more important to the gut than the other main short-chain fatty acids, acetate and propionate.
